app.no_bridge: This page needs the launcher (YO2OnlineLauncher.exe) to work.
app.updated: The launcher updated itself. Rejoining the server…
st.game_missing_tip: Click to pick the game folder in Settings
st.launcher_tip_on: Updates itself when you join a server that offers a new signed version
play.other_ver_tip: That server uses Ver.{v} and your game is Ver.{mine}
play.busy_tip: You're already connected to, or joining, a server
play.private_now_sub: ask the host for the room code
play.searching: Searching for servers on the P2P network…
play.none_found: No public servers found right now.
play.none_hint: You can host your own in “Host a server” or use “Join with code”.
play.private_hint: Can't see a server? Hidden servers only take the room code: use “Join with code”.
tag.cache_tip: From last time; checking whether it still answers
tag.noreply_tip: Not answering right now. It becomes active again by itself when it answers
tag.private_tip: This server is hidden now (not in the list). Ask the host for the room code and use “Join with code”.
tag.password_tip: Needs a password to join (or the room code)
tag.password_saved_tip: Needs a password: yours is saved on this PC
ping.relay_tip: Approximate: the server card came through a public relay
det.pick: Pick a server from the list to see its details.
det.pw_forget_tip: Forget the password saved on this PC
det.seen_private: answers, but it's hidden now (ask the host for the room code)
det.note: Players, rules and description are reported by the host itself. Two servers can share a name: check the fingerprint.
det.hide_tip: It won't show in your list again (you can restore it in Settings)
bar.nodes_tip_one: Connected to {n} node of the P2P network (network nodes, not players)
bar.nodes_tip_other: Connected to {n} nodes of the P2P network (network nodes, not players)
ov.ready_sub: The game is open. You can leave the launcher minimized: it keeps the connection.
ov.restarting_sub: It restarts by itself and rejoins “{name}”.
ov.restarting_sub_private: It restarts by itself and rejoins the server with the room code.
net.dir_empty: Type the host's address (IP or name, and port).
net.port_on_hint: Your server always listens on port {port} (TCP and UDP). Open it on your router so people can use “Join by address”.
net.port_off_hint: Off: a new random port each time. Joining through the public network works without touching your router.
net.port_restart: Your server is running on port {port}: this applies the next time you start it.
net.nodes_hint: All of them are used together, newest signed list first. Advanced: add your own in {file}, one per line (“bootstrap <multiaddr>” or “relay <multiaddr>”), then restart the launcher.
net.reach_private: behind a router: relays or Tor
net.port_busy: Port {wanted} is in use by another program, so this time your server uses port {port}. Pick another one in Settings → Network.
net.addr_label: Players type this in “Join by address”. Your room code stays secret: share it separately.
net.addr_copy_tip: Copy the address to the clipboard
net.addr_random: This port changes every time you start. Turn on “Fixed port” in Settings → Network to keep it.
net.open_port: To let people join by address, open TCP and UDP {port} on your router to {ip}.
net.open_port_noip: To let people join by address, open TCP and UDP {port} on your router to this PC.
net.random_port: Random port {port}. To let people join by address, turn on “Fixed port” in Settings → Network.
conf.disc_text: The game is open and will close: it can't keep running without the connection. Disconnect from “{name}”?
conf.disc_text_private: The game is open and will close: it can't keep running without the connection. Disconnect from the server?
conf.stop_text_one: {n} player is connected right now. Stopping the server will disconnect them. run.py will shut down gracefully (it saves and exits; this can take up to 30 s).
conf.stop_text_other: {n} players are connected right now. Stopping the server will disconnect them. run.py will shut down gracefully (it saves and exits; this can take up to 30 s).
conf.close_conn: You're connected to a server: closing the launcher cuts the connection.
conf.close_conn_game: You're connected to a server: closing the launcher cuts the connection and leaves the game without a server.
conf.close_srv: Your server is running: it will shut down gracefully (this can take up to 30 s) and players will be disconnected.
conf.close_srv_players_one: Your server is running with {n} player: it will shut down gracefully (this can take up to 30 s) and they will be disconnected.
conf.close_srv_players_other: Your server is running with {n} players: it will shut down gracefully (this can take up to 30 s) and they will be disconnected.
conf.switch_text: “{actual}” is running. Only one server can run at a time on this PC: stop it and start “{nuevo}”?
conf.switch_players_one: {n} player is connected and will be disconnected.
conf.switch_players_other: {n} players are connected and will be disconnected.
busy.title: One moment…
busy.stopping_text: run.py saves and shuts down gracefully; if it doesn't within 30 s, it's forced.
busy.closing_text_srv: Stopping the server gracefully: this can take up to 30 s.
srv.title: Your server
srv.intro: When started, your PC acts as a server for as long as the launcher is open. You can also play from this same PC.
srv.openserver: OpenServer.exe is open on this PC and uses the same host identity: close it to host from here.
srv.tunnel_count: run.py doesn't report its state: players are the guests with a tunnel.
srv.code_label: Room code (secret: share it only with whoever you want)
srv.code_skips_pw: The room code joins without the password: share it only with people you trust.
host.pw_keep: Password saved. Leave empty to keep it
host.none: No servers yet. Create one: it gets its own world, accounts and room code.
host.start_switch_tip: Another server is running: it will be stopped first
host.card_last: Up to {max} players · last started {ago} ago
host.rules_once: You pick the rules once: this server’s world is made with them.
host.rules_fixed: Rules are fixed per server. Create a new server to try the other rules.
host.hint_start: Press Start on one of your servers. Only one can run at a time.
host.hint_new: Create your first server to start hosting.
host.delete_text: “{name}” and its whole world (accounts, characters, bans, backups and logs) will be moved to the Recycle Bin. Its room code stops working.
host.delete_text_keep: “{name}” will be removed from My servers. Its world data stays where it is (it is your development copy) and is not deleted.
toast.hidden: “{name}” hidden. You can show it again in Settings.
toast.server_starting: Server starting: within a minute it shows up in the public list (if public).
toast.srv_created: “{name}” created. Press Start to run it.
toast.srv_deleted: “{name}” deleted (its folder is in the Recycle Bin).
set.game_missing: Can't find yo2.exe. Press “Change…” and pick the game folder.
set.game_other_ver: yo2.exe is Ver.{v}, but servers use Ver.{esperada}. Press “Change…” and pick the folder of the Ver.{esperada} client.
set.theme_hint: System follows the Windows light/dark setting.
set.win_hint: The game as it was made (1024x768). Takes effect the next time you open the game.
set.win_hint_zoom: Bigger window, same picture stretched; if it doesn't fit your screen it shrinks to fit. Takes effect the next time you open the game.
set.win_hint_fit: Borderless, as big as your screen allows, keeping 4:3 with black bars. Takes effect the next time you open the game.
msg.reanudar.sin_respuesta: The launcher updated, but the server you were in isn't answering. Pick it again in the list.
msg.act.otro_nombre: The host offers a file with a different name ({nombre}) instead of {esperado}: NOT installing it.
msg.act.sin_firma: The host offers a {nombre} without a valid publisher signature: NOT installing it.
msg.act.no_firmado: The host offers a {nombre} that isn't the signed one: NOT installing it.
msg.act.descargando: A new version of {nombre} is available ({version}, signed; {mb} MB): downloading it via {via}…
msg.act.tor_tarda: Over Tor this can take a few minutes. (To skip it: turn off “Auto-update” in Settings.)
msg.act.descarga_falla: Couldn't download the new version ({error}): staying on the current one.
msg.act.no_reemplaza: Can't replace {exe} ({error}): staying on the current version. You can copy {nuevo} over it by hand.
msg.act.renombra: WARNING: rename {viejo} back to {exe} by hand.
msg.act.no_instala: Couldn't install the new version ({motivo}): staying on the current one.
msg.act.motivo_copia: the copy doesn't match the download
msg.act.motivo_no_arranca: it won't start: {error}; did antivirus block it?
msg.act.motivo_se_cerro: the new version closed on startup ({error})
msg.aviso.probando_tor: Trying Tor: it can take a few minutes (longer the first time)…
msg.aviso.reconectando: Lost the connection to the host: reconnecting…
msg.via.p2p_holepunch: Direct P2P (over the Internet with hole punching, {tr})
msg.carpeta.no_encuentro: Can't find the game. Press “Change…” and pick the folder that contains yo2.exe.
msg.carpeta.otra_version: Folder saved, but that yo2.exe is Ver.{version} and servers use Ver.{esperada}.
msg.carpeta.sin_exe: yo2.exe isn't there. Pick the game folder (the one with yo2.exe inside).
msg.carpeta.sin_version: Folder saved, but couldn't read the version of yo2.exe: {error}
msg.carpeta.sin_version_desconocida: Folder saved, but couldn't tell which version this yo2.exe is.
msg.chk.juego_no: Can't find yo2.exe. Pick the folder in Settings.
msg.chk.version_desconocida: yo2.exe doesn't say which version it is.
msg.chk.puertos_propio: Your server is using them (normal while it's running).
msg.chk.puertos_ocupados: {n} port(s) in use (e.g. {ejemplo}): to join someone else's server you must close the program using them (is a run.py or JoinServer open?).
msg.chk.python_no: Not in PATH. Only needed to host a server.
msg.chk.runpy_no: Not next to the launcher. Only needed to host a server.
msg.chk.openserver_abierto: It's open: you can't host a server from here until you close it.
msg.err.codigo_formato: The code isn't valid: it should look like YO2-XXXXXX-XXXXXX-… (12 groups of 6).
msg.err.codigo_letra: The code isn't valid: a letter was copied wrong. Check it and try again.
msg.err.codigo_v1: That code is from the old version: ask the host for a new one.
msg.err.conectado_otro: You're connected to another server: disconnect first.
msg.err.entrar_generico: Couldn't join the server. See the technical details below.
msg.err.impostor: The server that answered isn't who it claims to be, so you won't be connected. Someone may be impersonating it.
msg.err.juego_abierto: A game is already open from this launcher: close it before joining another server.
msg.err.juego_ya_abierto: The game is already open from this launcher.
msg.err.lleno: The server is full right now. Try again in a bit.
msg.err.crossover: Couldn't open the game with CrossOver. In Settings, choose the game folder inside the bottle (the one with yo2.exe), or set YO2_CX_BOTTLE to the bottle name.
msg.err.no_abre_juego: Couldn't open the game. If you use antivirus, allow the folder %LOCALAPPDATA%\YO2Online (frida-inject.exe lives there).
msg.err.no_conectado: You're not connected to any server.
msg.err.no_python: Python wasn't found on this PC, and run.py needs it to start.
msg.err.no_runpy: Can't find run.py (the game server). YO2OnlineLauncher.exe must be inside the project's tools\yo2emu folder, next to run.py.
msg.err.openserver_abierto: OpenServer.exe is open on this PC and uses the same host identity: close it before hosting from here (otherwise they'd clash).
msg.err.otra_version: That server uses another game version and your yo2.exe can't join it.
msg.err.privado: This server is hidden now (only with the room code). Ask the host for the code and use “Join with code”.
msg.err.dir_formato: That address isn't valid. Type the host's IP or name and port, for example {ejemplo}.
msg.err.dir_oculta: That server only lets people in with its room code. Ask the host for it and choose “Room code”.
msg.err.dir_otro: A different server answers at that address, not the one your room code belongs to. Check the address and the code.
msg.err.dir_sin_respuesta: Nothing answers at that address. Check the IP and port, and ask the host to open that port (TCP and UDP) on their router.
msg.red.puerto_juego: The game uses that port. Pick another one (for example {por_defecto}).
msg.red.puerto_rango: The port must be between 1024 and 65535.
msg.red.sin_direccion: Your public address isn't known yet.
msg.err.clave_intentos: Too many wrong passwords. Wait a minute and try again.
msg.err.sin_sitio: The host can’t take another connection right now. Try again in a bit.
msg.err.puerto_ocupado: A game port is already in use on this PC (another launcher, or your own server?). Close it and try again.
msg.err.runpy_no_contesta: You reached the host, but their game server isn't responding. Let them know: they may need to start run.py.
msg.err.runpy_no_escucha: The game server (run.py) isn't listening yet. Wait a few seconds.
msg.err.sin_camino: Couldn't reach the server directly (P2P) or through Tor. It may be offline, or your network is blocking it.
msg.err.sin_carpeta: Can't open the folder from here.
msg.err.sin_juego: Can't find yo2.exe. Pick the game folder in Settings.
msg.err.sin_portapapeles: The clipboard isn't available from here.
msg.err.srv_publico: Your server is public: no code needed.
msg.err.ya_conectado: You're already connected to “{nombre}”. Disconnect before joining another.
msg.err.ya_conectado_privado: You're already connected to a server (room code). Disconnect before joining another.
msg.err.ya_no_esta: That server is no longer in the list. Press “Refresh”.
msg.form.desc_larga: The description is too long (max {max} characters).
msg.form.max_rango: Max players must be between {min} and {max}.
msg.form.nombre_largo: The name is too long (max {max} characters).
msg.form.reglas: Choose the rules: Vanilla or Enhanced.
msg.form.nivel: The starting level must be between 1 and {max}.
msg.form.dp: The starting Duelpass points must be between 1 and {max}.
msg.form.regalos: Starting gifts must be between 0 and 1,000,000.
msg.form.regalos_baul: The starting trunk mode is invalid.
msg.form.clave_vacia: Type a password for your server.
msg.form.clave_corta: The password needs at least {min} characters.
msg.form.clave_larga: The password can have at most {max} characters.
msg.form.clave_rara: The password has characters that aren't allowed (control or invisible characters).
msg.listado.anunciando: announcing (the first announcement takes about a minute)
msg.listado.error_dht: error: can't reach the public DHT (no Internet, or outgoing UDP/TCP blocked?)
msg.paquete.datos_fallo: Couldn't prepare the game data for your server: {detalle}
msg.paquete.sin_juego: To host a server the launcher needs your game folder (yo2.exe Ver.080912). Pick it in Settings.
msg.p2p.error_dht: can't reach the public DHT (no Internet, or outgoing UDP/TCP blocked?)
msg.red.alcance_privada: behind a router with no open port
msg.red.corto_tor: some players may join via Tor
msg.red.hp_fallo: last direct connection failed: that player joined through Tor (slower, still works)
msg.red.nat_simetrico: symmetric NAT for {proto} (hole punching almost never works)
msg.srv.runpy_ajeno: A run.py was already running on this PC, so that one is used. The form's rules and accounts don't apply to it (they stay as they were) and “Stop server” doesn't close it.
msg.srv.no_existe: That server is no longer in My servers.
msg.srv.nombre_repetido: You already have a server called “{nombre}”. Pick another name.
msg.srv.reglas_fijas: Rules are fixed per server. Create a new server to try the other rules.
msg.srv.editar_en_marcha: Stop this server before editing it.
msg.srv.borrar_nombre: Type the exact server name to delete it.
msg.srv.borrar_en_marcha: You can’t delete the server that is running. Stop it first.
msg.srv.borrar_fallo: Couldn’t move the server folder to the Recycle Bin: {error}
msg.srv.otro_en_marcha: “{nombre}” is running. Only one server can run at a time on this PC (they share the game ports): stop it first.
msg.srv.clave_falta: This server needs a password and none is saved. Press Edit and type one.
msg.srv.runpy_ajeno_nuevo: A game server (run.py) that this launcher didn’t start is already running on this PC. “{nombre}” has its own world: close that run.py first.
msg.tor.diag_0: {progreso}. tor.exe isn't advancing: has antivirus blocked it?
msg.tor.diag_bloqueado: {progreso}. It can't reach any Tor relay: this network seems to BLOCK Tor (it happens on some company, university or public Wi-Fi networks)
msg.tor.diag_circuitos: {progreso}. Connected to the Tor network but still building circuits
msg.tor.diag_descargando: {progreso}. NOT blocked: it's downloading the Tor network directory (the first time takes several minutes; later ones, seconds, because it's saved)
msg.parar.ajeno: run.py wasn't started by this launcher: it isn't touched.
msg.parar.con_orden: run.py shut down gracefully (saved and exited) in {seg} s.
msg.parar.forzado: run.py didn't shut down within {seg} s and had to be killed: anything unsaved may have been lost.
msg.parar.fuera_lista: The server is no longer in the list and no longer accepts guests.
msg.parar.m_cierra_sin_contestar: the run.py console closed without answering (stale token?)
msg.parar.m_no_habla: couldn't talk to the run.py console ({error})
msg.parar.m_respuesta: run.py answered “{respuesta}” to the shutdown order
msg.parar.m_sin_token: can't find the run.py console token ({error})
msg.parar.m_token_malo: the run.py console token isn't valid
msg.parar.motivo: Reason it couldn't shut down gracefully: {motivo}.
msg.parar.runpy_ajeno: run.py wasn't started by this launcher, so it's left running.
msg.parar.solo: run.py closed on its own in {seg} s.
mg.wait_server: The game server is still starting. Manage will load as soon as it's ready.
mg.kick_text: They are disconnected right now, but they can log in again straight away. To keep someone out, ban them instead.
mg.ban_text: Their account can't log in until you unban it. They are disconnected right now.
mg.bans_none: No banned accounts. Players you ban show up here.
mg.unban_text: They will be able to log in again.
mg.acc_open_hint: Registration is open: anyone who logs in gets an account automatically, so you don't need to create accounts here. To choose who can play, set Accounts to “Only accounts I create” when you start the server.
mg.acc_note_closed: Only the accounts listed here can log in. Usernames and passwords take 1 to {max} characters. A password is never shown again.
mg.acc_note_open: Usernames and passwords take 1 to {max} characters. A password is never shown again.
mg.del_tip_owner: The owner account can't be deleted.
mg.del_tip_online: Kick them first: connected accounts can't be deleted.
mg.del_tip_chars: Only empty accounts (no characters) can be deleted.
mg.acc_fill: Fill in the username and the password.
mg.pw_text: They will log in with the new password. Their characters and cards stay the same. The old password stops working.
mg.del_text: This empty account is removed and its login stops working.
mg.notice_hint: Players see it in the in-game chat as a system message (not while they are in My Room). Up to 200 characters.
mg.t_notice_nobody: Nobody is online, so nobody got it.
mg.backup_hint: Saves a copy of the server's data (accounts, characters, cards) next to the original, so you can go back if something goes wrong.
mg.level_text: Level 1 players can only enter the beginner rooms (like the original game). From level 2 they can join every room, and the beginner rooms are hidden for them.
mg.level_tip_nochar: They haven't picked a character yet.
mg.t_level_later: {name} is now level {n}. They'll see it the next time they enter a room.
mg.dp_text: Each duel costs 1 Duelpass point, and a match needs 3 to start. Without points the game won't let them challenge anyone. MP is the money for the shop.
mg.dp_now_unknown: This character has no saved data yet (they haven't entered a room).
mg.dp_range_set: Type whole numbers from 0 to 9,999,999 (leave a box empty to keep it).
mg.dp_range_add: Type whole numbers (negative to take away; leave a box empty to keep it).
mg.dp_empty: Type how many Duelpass points or MP.
mg.t_dp_later: {name} now has {dp} DP and {mp} MP. They'll see it the next time they enter a room.
mg.duelpass_none: No DUELPASS codes have been created.
mg.duelpass_created: Created {n} codes and copied them to the clipboard.
mg.duelpass_bad: Check the code quantity and reward values.
mg.duelpass_start_saved: Starting gifts saved for new characters.
msg.gestion.sin_token: This server doesn't offer the Manage tab yet: it is running older server files. Stop it and start it again.
msg.gestion.no_responde: The server didn't answer the Manage request ({error}). Is it still starting?
msg.gestion.respuesta_mala: The server sent something the launcher can't read.
msg.gestion.token_malo: The server doesn't accept the launcher's key. It may have restarted: open the Manage tab again.
msg.gestion.bloqueado: Too many wrong attempts: try again in a minute.
msg.gestion.no_duelpass: The server does not have DUELPASS administration installed.
msg.gestion.no_torneos: The server does not have tournament administration installed.
msg.gestion.no_eventos: The server does not have the event engine installed.
msg.gestion.evento_regla: This event rule is not available for YO2 Ver.080912.
msg.gestion.duelpass_no_existe: That DUELPASS code does not exist.
msg.gestion.duelpass_recompensa: The selected card or starter deck is not valid.
msg.gestion.no_conectado: That player isn't connected any more.
msg.gestion.dueno: The owner account can't be kicked, banned or deleted.
msg.gestion.no_existe: That account doesn't exist any more.
msg.gestion.entrada: Not valid: usernames and passwords take 1 to 16 characters; announcements and reasons up to 200.
msg.gestion.ya_existe: There is already an account with that username (or with that username and password).
msg.gestion.tope: The server already has the maximum number of accounts.
msg.gestion.usuario_otro: That isn't the username of this account.
msg.gestion.conectada: That account is connected: kick them first.
msg.gestion.con_personajes: That account has characters: only empty accounts can be deleted.
msg.gestion.sin_cifrado: The server is missing its accounts module.
msg.gestion.nivel: The level must be between 1 and {max}.
msg.gestion.puntos: Points must be whole numbers from 0 to {max} (when adding, negative numbers take away).
msg.gestion.hueco: That account has several characters: choose one.
msg.gestion.sin_personaje: That character doesn't exist any more.
